name: Totemic Mettle (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Must possess the totemic sage archetype.

Benefit: Whenever you enter a rage while bound to a spirit that belongs to your associated constellation, whenever you succeed on a Fortitude save that would normally have a lesser effect on a successful save, you instead completely negate the effect. You are still harmed by the effects that do not allow a saving throw.
